scope: Independent read-only review of renderer patch. No frontend tests or renderer runs executed by this reviewer; observed DOM evidence is read from builder artifacts.

confirmedFindings.issue: Combining marks counted as independently sounded characters stop a measured vowel fill when the browser Range shares its base glyph bounds.
confirmedFindings.reproduction: Actual Electron unicode-probe.json: мо́ре starts[0,.1,.7,.7,.8], position.4 gives .3051728405 (vowel entry); ёлка starts[0,.6,.6,.7,.8] gives0.
confirmedFindings.resolution: Builder added Unicode mark class \p{M} to silentCharacter with u flag; codepoint indices and saved starts remain unchanged. Two regression cases added. Final rerun belongs to builder full affected gate.

confirmedFindings.issue: New non-null assertions conflicted with project rule checker.
confirmedFindings.resolution: Builder removed assertions using explicit missing-node/observer guards and typed fixture tuple.

checks.result: KaraokeLyrics1.3.2 emits current p.ad-lyrics-current with key=currentKey, spans in word order and first text child=word.text, followed by a space. id propagates through mark(). The hook binds current, never preview/next. Changing line changes line.words ref and replaces observer/geometry.

Stable noWords array while hidden; transitions into final countdown second select actual current.words and force measure. Going backward to hidden removes measured entries. CurrentLineIndex and line timing rules unchanged.
Measurement effect dependencies id, words, font; playback/seek uses paint only. ResizeObserver observes current line; FontFaceSet.loadingdone remeasures. No layout reads in per-render paint.
Dependency change/unmount disconnects observer, removes font listener, clears measured ref. No timers or animation loops added.

Heading font choice is passed explicitly. Responsive line dimensions trigger ResizeObserver. Existing beat scale transforms glyph and word bounds equally, so ratio stays valid without every-frame measurements.

Array iteration uses codepoints as Python letter arrays do; DOM Range offsets advance by character.length (UTF16 code units), preserving surrogate pair offsets. No text normalization that would change saved indices.

ь/ъ/apostrophe/whitespace/combining marks have no independent display interval. Glyph width shares previous sounding group; trailing punctuation and layout space do not consume sound time. This does NOT establish acoustic duration of final consonants.

Helper reads EditorWord and changes only existing DOM --ad-lyric-fill. It neither mutates words/letters/notes nor changes audio, word times, currentLineIndex, model inference, persistence, or schemas.
Without timings, existing consonant/vowel heuristic stays approximate; physical mapping uses glyph geometry. No global minimum duration or delay introduced.

testReview: Rendered glyph boundary and whole-percent rounding regression coverage present.
Cache, backward seeks, font changes, ResizeObserver/font completion and cleanup coverage present.
RU/UK, soft signs/apostrophes, fast word, held vowel, legacy no-letter timing coverage present.
Requested stricter expected fractions for combining-mark tests (.44 and .133333) instead of >start only.
limitations: Renderer pixel accuracy verifies mapping to saved times, not the acoustic truth of those saved times.
Soft-sign grouping cannot certify the backend final consonant/tail acoustic interval.
This review is not a Windows live karaoke/audio-device gate.
